description: Whether a study's title reads as a clinical trial's. The answer gates one risk indicator, 'Clinical trial without detected registration', raised when a registry was asked and holds nothing. Each pattern is a regex fragment applied to the lowercased title, and a fragment matches only as a whole word: the platforms wrap the alternation as (?<![a-z0-9])(?:p1|p2|...)(?![a-z0-9]). A bare substring test, which all three platforms used until #385, read 'atrial fibrillation' as a trial (via 'trial'), 'myocardial infarction' (via 'rct'), 'industrial' and 'gas phase isomerisation' (via 'phase i'). Asserted string-for-string and order-sensitively against each platform's list, and behaviourally through each platform's own matcher over the cases below.
